Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro call yesterday — the team at Acme AI is evaluating Redwood's Hosted API for a production integration (we're particularly interested in SDKs, streaming, and function/tool calling). We'd love to schedule a technical deep-dive/architecture review with your engineers next week to cover integration patterns, streaming best practices, and function calling examples.

Are you available to propose 2–3 slots? We're US/PST.

Thanks,
